mapper.sql: s.id, s.play_instance_id, s.activity_id, s.topic_id, s.node_id, s.template_id, s.owner_type, s.owner_id, s.config_snapshot_json, s.state_json, s.status, s.score, s.completed_units, s.version, s.started_at, s.deadline_at, s.completed_at, s.create_time, s.update_time
mapper.insert: insert into game_runtime_session (play_instance_id, activity_id, topic_id, node_id, template_id, owner_type, owner_id, config_snapshot_json, state_json, status, score, completed_units, version, started_at, deadline_at, completed_at, create_time, update_time) values (#{playInstanceId}, #{activityId}, #{topicId}, #{nodeId}, #{templateId}, #{ownerType}, #{ownerId}, #{configSnapshotJson}, #{stateJson}, #{status}, #{score}, #{completedUnits}, #{version}, #{startedAt}, #{deadlineAt}, #{completedAt}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.select:
select from game_runtime_session s where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.node_id=#{nodeId} and s.owner_type=#{ownerType} and s.owner_id=#{ownerId} and json_valid(s.state_json) and json_extract(s.state_json,'$.zeroChallengeInstance') is not null
and (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(s.state_json,'$.originalGameSessionId')) as unsigned)=#{gameSessionId} or json_extract(s.state_json,'$.originalGameSessionId') is null and s.play_instance_id like concat('game:',#{gameSessionId},':challenge:%')) and cast(json_unquote(json_extract(s.state_json,'$.runtimeAuthorityEpoch')) as unsigned)=#{authorityEpoch}
and (cast(json_unquote(json_extract(s.state_json,'$.originalRouteSessionId')) as unsigned)=#{routeSessionId} or json_extract(s.state_json,'$.originalRouteSessionId') is null and exists ( select 1 from topic_route_action a join topic_route_session r on r.id=a.session_id where r.id=#{routeSessionId} and r.activity_id=s.activity_id and r.topic_id=s.topic_id and r.member_id=s.owner_id and a.member_id=s.owner_id and a.node_id=s.node_id and a.outcome_code='CHALLENGE' and json_valid(a.response_json) and json_unquote(json_extract(a.response_json,'$.instanceId'))= json_unquote(json_extract(s.state_json,'$.zeroChallengeInstance'))))
and 1=0
order by s.id desc limit 1

select from game_runtime_session s where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.node_id=#{nodeId} and s.owner_type=#{ownerType} and s.owner_id=#{ownerId} and s.play_instance_id=coalesce((select r.play_instance_id from topic_route_session r where r.member_id=s.owner_id and s.owner_type=1 and r.topic_id=s.topic_id and r.activity_id=s.activity_id order by r.id desc limit 1),'default') limit 1
select from game_runtime_session s where s.id=#{id} for update

select from game_runtime_session s where s.id=#{id} and ( (s.owner_type=1 and s.owner_id=#{memberId}) or (s.owner_type=2 and exists ( select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=s.owner_id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 )) ) limit 1

select from game_runtime_session s where s.id=#{id} and ( (s.owner_type=1 and s.owner_id=#{memberId}) or (s.owner_type=2 and exists ( select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=s.owner_id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 for update )) ) limit 1 for update

select s.state_json from game_runtime_session s where s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.play_instance_id=coalesce((select r.play_instance_id from topic_route_session r where r.member_id=s.owner_id and s.owner_type=1 and r.topic_id=s.topic_id and r.activity_id=s.activity_id order by r.id desc limit 1),'default') and ( (s.owner_type=1 and s.owner_id=#{memberId}) or (s.owner_type=2 and exists ( select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=s.owner_id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 )) ) order by s.node_id, s.id

select from game_runtime_session s where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.node_id=#{nodeId} and s.owner_type=1 and s.owner_id=#{memberId} and s.play_instance_id=coalesce((select r.play_instance_id from topic_route_session r where r.member_id=s.owner_id and s.owner_type=1 and r.topic_id=s.topic_id and r.activity_id=s.activity_id order by r.id desc limit 1),'default') limit 1

select from game_runtime_session s where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.play_instance_id='default' and ((s.owner_type=1 and s.owner_id=#{memberId}) or (s.owner_type=2 and exists ( select 1 from play_team_member m where m.team_id=s.owner_id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1))) order by s.id

select from game_runtime_session s join play_team_member m on m.team_id=s.owner_id and m.member_id=#{memberId} and m.status=1 where s.activity_id=#{activityId} and s.topic_id=#{topicId} and s.node_id=#{nodeId} and s.owner_type=2 order by s.id desc limit 1
mapper.update: update game_runtime_session set state_json=#{stateJson}, status=#{status}, score=#{score}, completed_units=#{completedUnits}, completed_at=#{completedAt}, version=version+1, update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and status=0

update game_runtime_session set state_json=#{stateJson}, status=0, score=0, completed_units=0, started_at=#{startedAt}, deadline_at=#{deadlineAt}, completed_at=null, version=version+1, update_time=#{updateTime} where id=#{id} and version=#{version} and status in (2, 3)
